name: Kalit
description:
About This Game

Dive into a massive 1930s cartoon open world where everything is out to get you. Hunt, capture, and command quirky creatures to fight your battles and automate your base. Climb every mountain, glide across the map, and shoot down wacky enemies. You'll need to scavenge resources, farm crops, and manage your sanity and body temperature to survive the wild!

Submerge yourself and explore an underwater world filled with shipwrecks, hidden resources, and lurking dangers.

Build your base underwater, explore the deep seas, and discover water creatures.

Hand-drawn 1930s Chaos

Watch the world come alive! Every animation is painstakingly hand-drawn using the classic "rubber hose" technique, bringing nostalgic cartoon charm into a fully 3D environment.

Explore & Uncover Secrets

Land and sea depths await you! Venture through bizarre lands, track down hidden minigames, and dig deep into pitch-black mines.

Fight

Not all creatures are friendly! Craft vintage-flavored weapons, including guns that look like they're straight out of an old cartoon, and prepare for explosive encounters.

Collect & Command Creatures

The bizarre creatures of this world can become your greatest allies. Tame the local wildlife to help you in exploration, base defense, and resource gathering. With the right care, you'll see them evolve into even more extravagant and powerful forms!

Meet Eccentric Locals

You aren't the only one wandering this wild island! Seek out and talk to a cast of wacky, fully-animated characters. Chat with the locals to uncover hidden lore, take on peculiar quests, and trade for rare, valuable items.

Gather, Mine & Build

An axe with eyes? Sure! Chop down trees, or arm yourself with your trusty pickaxe to extract precious shiny metals. Use your resources to build a custom base with automated defenses, or assemble incredible vehicles with a retro touch—from mechs that roam the mainland to flying machines that rule the skies.

Survive & Farm

In this wacky world, hunger and thirst are just the beginning! You will need to fight off the freezing cold, beat the blistering heat, and keep your sanity from dropping into madness. Plant quirky seeds, tend to animated saplings, and harvest crops to keep your energy up for new adventures.

Key Features

  • Experience 1930s cartoon chaos: A beautiful, fully hand-drawn "rubber hose" art style set in a massive 3D environment.

  • Capture and command creatures: Catch bizarre local wildlife to fight alongside you or automate your base.

  • Explore a massive open world: Climb any surface, glide through the skies, and swim through deep waters.

  • Talk to wacky NPCs: Meet a cast of quirky locals to trade, accept quests, and learn the secrets of the island.

  • Build and craft: Mine deep for precious ores, refine materials, and construct your ultimate retro base and vehicles.

  • Master survival mechanics: Manage your hunger, temperature, and keep your sanity from dropping into madness!

  • Farm, fish, and forage: Plant seeds, irrigate crops, and cast your fishing line to keep starvation at bay.

  • Shoot and smash enemies: Craft wacky weapons and blast your way through hostile wildlife, aggressive mobs, and giant bosses.

  • Level up: Gain XP and unlock new abilities and recipes in a deep progression system.

Join the Community!

We are an indie studio formed by two video game enthusiasts. The game is currently in the very early stages of development, and your feedback is vital in helping us shape it. Come say hello, share your ideas, and follow our progress by joining our community on Discord!
short_desc: A unique survival adventure, animated in a 1930s rubber hose style! Fight to survive: capture creatures, farm, mine, and craft everything you need: from gear and vehicles to your base. Explore strange lands and an underwater world of shipwrecks, dangers, and hidden wonders.
